comments.body: Landed 2026-10-29: api.read_pane (b3450d99..aed37971, the panes slot); the API corpus, nine files of recorded conversations in canonical protobuf JSON replayed by the gate (568bf14f), with ./release keeping the corpus as each release ships it and the gate holding shipped cases unchanged until the version moves; muster docs api and --schema; AGENTS.md non-goal and Driving Muster, architecture.md's API connection and event rules; extras/api-client-go, a Go client generated from the published schema, run outside the gate with its transcript. Plan reviewed by Codex xhigh (2 P1, 2 P2 taken); code by Codex and Claude (P2s fixed). Also the held-queue budget fix (fb93204e). Full gate green.

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
MIP-10 stage 1, part 5 of 5: the rest of stage 1. Read docs/mip/0010-api-for-other-tools.md sections 4 and 9, and How it lands.

What: `api.read_pane`, pages of a pane's text as `muster pane read` gives them; the API corpus in corpus/ (recorded API conversations the gate replays against the daemon, failing when an answer changes unless the change bumps the API version); `muster docs api`, a docs/cli topic saying where the socket is and what each request and topic does, and `muster docs api --schema` printing muster_api.proto; and the doctrine changes in section 9 (the AGENTS.md non-goal, docs/architecture.md's protocol section). Do it last in stage 1, when parts 2-4 have landed, so the corpus and docs cover them.

Proves: the gate replays the corpus; `muster docs api` is reachable as the gate requires of docs/cli; a client generated from `muster docs api --schema` in another language (TypeScript or Go is enough) subscribes and reads panes.
title: MIP-10 stage 1e: read_pane, the API corpus, muster docs api and doctrine
